items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: One is Jason Harnell, who’s worked a lot of gigs down in L.A.

ctx.x: He’s the baby in the family. And Tony. There were three drummers in the family: Tony, who lives in Arizona; and Hank is the baby – Hank lives in Encino; and myself. Hank teaches. He won’t take a student that wants to learn just a rock beat. He says, “You’ll have to go to someone else, because if you want to learn how to play drums, I’ll teach you, but you have to have patience.” Some of his patients were good players. One is Jason Harnell, who’s worked a lot of gigs down in L.A. Another one is Jeremy. Vic…
Those are invaluable words of wisdom. Is there anything else you want to make sure gets on the national record as far as the life and times of Louie Bellson, before we complete this interview?
